name: HIA exact Git source custody

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'codex/hia-source-custody-*'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  export-exact-commit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact event commit and its real shallow boundary
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          fetch-tags: false
          persist-credentials: false
          submodules: false
          lfs: false
          show-progress: false
      - name: Export all Git objects and independently reconstruct the checkout
        id: package
        env:
          PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
        run: |
          python3 -I -S -B - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          import subprocess, sys
          source = Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE']).resolve()
          root = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'hia-source-custody-artifact'
          root.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=False)
          package = root / 'package'
          destination = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'hia-source-custody-reconstructed'
          reproduction = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'hia-source-custody-clone-reproduction'
          tool = source / 'experiments/hia_git_source_package_20261111/source_package.py'
          commit = os.environ['GITHUB_SHA']
          subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-S', '-B', str(tool), 'export',
                          '--source-root', str(source), '--output-dir', str(package),
                          '--expected-commit', commit], check=True)
          raw = (package / 'manifest.json').read_bytes()
          manifest = json.loads(raw)
          manifest_sha = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
          subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-S', '-B', str(package / 'source-package.py'),
                          'materialize', '--package', str(package),
                          '--destination', str(destination), '--expected-commit', commit,
                          '--reproduction-destination', str(reproduction),
                          '--expected-tree', manifest['tree'], '--manifest-sha256', manifest_sha,
                          '--report', str(root / 'reconstruction.json')], check=True)
          receipt = {
              'schema': 'hepta.hia.actions-source-custody.v1',
              'status': 'PASS', 'qualification_executed': False,
              'repository': os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY'],
              'commit': commit, 'tree': manifest['tree'],
              'manifest_sha256': manifest_sha, 'pack': manifest['pack'],
              'counts': manifest['counts'],
              'workflow_ref': os.environ['GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF'],
              'workflow_sha': os.environ['GITHUB_WORKFLOW_SHA'],
              'run_id': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'],
              'run_attempt': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'],
              'event_name': os.environ['GITHUB_EVENT_NAME'],
              'shallow_boundary': manifest['shallow']['exported_boundary'],
              'ancestor_history_included': False,
          }
          with (root / 'IDENTITY.json').open('x') as stream:
              json.dump(receipt, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2)
              stream.write('\n')
          print(json.dumps(receipt, sort_keys=True))
          PY
      - name: Preserve package and any original failure receipts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: hia-source-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-source-custody-artifact/
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
          retention-days: 14
